meta.title: The Journey Continues
meta.description: There's always another quest for a hero.

units.rawText: Sticky slime drops from my torso.
units.displayText: Sticky slime drops from my torso.

spans.text: Sticky slime drops from my torso.

units.rawText: I open my eyes, straining to take in any light around me. But no matter how I try, the world before me is nothing but pure darkness.
units.displayText: I open my eyes, straining to take in any light around me. But no matter how I try, the world before me is nothing but pure darkness.

spans.text: I open my eyes, straining to take in any light around me. But no matter how I try, the world before me is nothing but pure darkness.

units.rawText: An invisible yet powerful force surrounds me, as though I was bound by countless stout ropes, tightly binding my limbs.
units.displayText: An invisible yet powerful force surrounds me, as though I was bound by countless stout ropes, tightly binding my limbs.

spans.text: An invisible yet powerful force surrounds me, as though I was bound by countless stout ropes, tightly binding my limbs.

units.rawText: My mightiest shouts are reduced to nothing but weak whimperings that ripple away from me before they vanish into this endless chasm of despair.
units.displayText: My mightiest shouts are reduced to nothing but weak whimperings that ripple away from me before they vanish into this endless chasm of despair.

spans.text: My mightiest shouts are reduced to nothing but weak whimperings that ripple away from me before they vanish into this endless chasm of despair.

units.rawText: Enough time has passed that the very idea of duration has lost its meaning. My mind slowly fades away in the infinite silence, and there is only one thing that stands out to me—
units.displayText: Enough time has passed that the very idea of duration has lost its meaning. My mind slowly fades away in the infinite silence, and there is only one thing that stands out to me—

spans.text: Enough time has passed that the very idea of duration has lost its meaning. My mind slowly fades away in the infinite silence, and there is only one thing that stands out to me—

units.rawText: I will never escape this dark cage that is hidden from the sun.
units.displayText: I will never escape this dark cage that is hidden from the sun.

spans.text: I will never escape this dark cage that is hidden from the sun.

units.rawText: Professor... Professor!
units.displayText: Professor... Professor!

spans.text: Professor... Professor!

units.rawText: Prof! Wake up, Prof! Should we do mouth-to-mouth...
units.displayText: Prof! Wake up, Prof! Should we do mouth-to-mouth...

spans.text: Prof! Wake up, Prof! Should we do mouth-to-mouth...

units.rawText: I can't, I'm an Entropic... The Professor might get infected...
units.displayText: I can't, I'm an Entropic... The Professor might get infected...

spans.text: I can't, I'm an Entropic... The Professor might get infected...

units.rawText: A hint of sound comes through the dead silence. Unlike the dripping, it sounds more like a frantic cry.
units.displayText: A hint of sound comes through the dead silence. Unlike the dripping, it sounds more like a frantic cry.

spans.text: A hint of sound comes through the dead silence. Unlike the dripping, it sounds more like a frantic cry.

units.rawText: Who are they talking about? Who's this Professor?
units.displayText: Who are they talking about? Who's this Professor?

spans.text: Who are they talking about? Who's this Professor?

units.rawText: Is it me?
units.displayText: Is it me?

spans.text: Is it me?

units.rawText: Yes... I'm the Oasis' Professor...
units.displayText: Yes... I'm the Oasis' Professor...

spans.text: Yes... I'm the Oasis' Professor...

units.rawText: My slumbering memories gradually come back to me. Persicaria and I entered the Tartarus Sector and then we ran into Entropic Sol. In order to stop her, I activated a sentry gun and got knocked out in the process...
units.displayText: My slumbering memories gradually come back to me. Persicaria and I entered the Tartarus Sector and then we ran into Entropic Sol. In order to stop her, I activated a sentry gun and got knocked out in the process...

spans.text: My slumbering memories gradually come back to me. Persicaria and I entered the Tartarus Sector and then we ran into Entropic Sol. In order to stop her, I activated a sentry gun and got knocked out in the process...

units.rawText: Professor, I'm Persicaria! Wake up!
units.displayText: Professor, I'm Persicaria! Wake up!

spans.text: Professor, I'm Persicaria! Wake up!

units.rawText: A warm light shines through the darkness, illuminating a tired face in the abyss.
units.displayText: A warm light shines through the darkness, illuminating a tired face in the abyss.

spans.text: A warm light shines through the darkness, illuminating a tired face in the abyss.

units.rawText: Per...sicaria...
units.displayText: Per...sicaria...

spans.text: Per...sicaria...

units.rawText: I reach out to try and grasp the sole source of light in the night.
units.displayText: I reach out to try and grasp the sole source of light in the night.

spans.text: I reach out to try and grasp the sole source of light in the night.

units.rawText: The moment my fingertips touch it, the light intensifies, expanding rapidly like a breaking dawn. One familiar face after another appears before me.
units.displayText: The moment my fingertips touch it, the light intensifies, expanding rapidly like a breaking dawn. One familiar face after another appears before me.

spans.text: The moment my fingertips touch it, the light intensifies, expanding rapidly like a breaking dawn. One familiar face after another appears before me.

units.rawText: <size=40>PROFESSOR!!!</size>
units.displayText: PROFESSOR!!!

spans.text: PROFESSOR!!!

units.rawText: Are you awake at last? I thought we'd have to drag you to meet Malkira.
units.displayText: Are you awake at last? I thought we'd have to drag you to meet Malkira.

spans.text: Are you awake at last? I thought we'd have to drag you to meet Malkira.

units.rawText: Huh? You're not surprised to see me? Well, that's the Prof for you, always calm no matter what kind of fresh hell rears its ugly head. Definitely someone who's seen things you wouldn't believe.
units.displayText: Huh? You're not surprised to see me? Well, that's the Prof for you, always calm no matter what kind of fresh hell rears its ugly head. Definitely someone who's seen things you wouldn't believe.

spans.text: Huh? You're not surprised to see me? Well, that's the Prof for you, always calm no matter what kind of fresh hell rears its ugly head. Definitely someone who's seen things you wouldn't believe.

units.rawText: Persicaria... S-Sol...
units.displayText: Persicaria... S-Sol...

spans.text: Persicaria... S-Sol...

units.rawText: Still fresh from the darkness, I reflexively call her name in a daze.
units.displayText: Still fresh from the darkness, I reflexively call her name in a daze.

spans.text: Still fresh from the darkness, I reflexively call her name in a daze.

units.rawText: And...
units.displayText: And...

spans.text: And...

units.rawText: The black-garbed girl standing off to the side nods to me by way of answer.
units.displayText: The black-garbed girl standing off to the side nods to me by way of answer.

spans.text: The black-garbed girl standing off to the side nods to me by way of answer.

units.rawText: At first, I thought Sol had shaken off her Entropization through some miracle. However, circumstances suggest otherwise. Then this Sol...
units.displayText: At first, I thought Sol had shaken off her Entropization through some miracle. However, circumstances suggest otherwise. Then this Sol...

spans.text: At first, I thought Sol had shaken off her Entropization through some miracle. However, circumstances suggest otherwise. Then this Sol...

units.rawText: The girl in orange waves her hand to me to test my reaction, and I note that her fingers are translucent.
units.displayText: The girl in orange waves her hand to me to test my reaction, and I note that her fingers are translucent.

spans.text: The girl in orange waves her hand to me to test my reaction, and I note that her fingers are translucent.

units.rawText: Wow, you're slow. Did that cannon blast give you a concussion or something?
units.displayText: Wow, you're slow. Did that cannon blast give you a concussion or something?

spans.text: Wow, you're slow. Did that cannon blast give you a concussion or something?

units.rawText: Well, if she can say that, she must be the original Sol.
units.displayText: Well, if she can say that, she must be the original Sol.

spans.text: Well, if she can say that, she must be the original Sol.

units.rawText: So you're still Entropized. Does that mean you're a projection or that you've been resurrected by some other scientific method?
units.displayText: So you're still Entropized. Does that mean you're a projection or that you've been resurrected by some other scientific method?

spans.text: So you're still Entropized. Does that mean you're a projection or that you've been resurrected by some other scientific method?

units.rawText: Sol put a neural fragment into her necklace bottle before she died. After coming to Tartarus, the fragment resonated with the part of Entropic Sol's neural cloud contained within her stake, and they combined into a new core.
units.displayText: Sol put a neural fragment into her necklace bottle before she died. After coming to Tartarus, the fragment resonated with the part of Entropic Sol's neural cloud contained within her stake, and they combined into a new core.

spans.text: Sol put a neural fragment into her necklace bottle before she died. After coming to Tartarus, the fragment resonated with the part of Entropic Sol's neural cloud contained within her stake, and they combined into a new core.

units.rawText: Also, with Entropic Sol infusing her with operands, she ought to be able to hang around for a while.
units.displayText: Also, with Entropic Sol infusing her with operands, she ought to be able to hang around for a while.

spans.text: Also, with Entropic Sol infusing her with operands, she ought to be able to hang around for a while.

units.rawText: Hey, what do you mean by "hanging around"? Did you already forget how I saved all your asses right after I came back?
units.displayText: Hey, what do you mean by "hanging around"? Did you already forget how I saved all your asses right after I came back?

spans.text: Hey, what do you mean by "hanging around"? Did you already forget how I saved all your asses right after I came back?

units.rawText: I see... Looks like many factors came together to create a miracle.
units.displayText: I see... Looks like many factors came together to create a miracle.

spans.text: I see... Looks like many factors came together to create a miracle.

units.rawText: In any case, I'm glad to see you again. <color=orange>Welcome back, Sol.</color>
units.displayText: In any case, I'm glad to see you again. Welcome back, Sol.

spans.text: In any case, I'm glad to see you again.
Welcome back, Sol.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Hehe, I'm glad to be back, Prof.</color>
units.displayText: Hehe, I'm glad to be back, Prof.

spans.text: Hehe, I'm glad to be back, Prof.

units.rawText: Sol gives me a big hug. Her familiar strength fills me with warmth.
units.displayText: Sol gives me a big hug. Her familiar strength fills me with warmth.

spans.text: Sol gives me a big hug. Her familiar strength fills me with warmth.

units.rawText: Still, you've only just woken up. Perhaps a quick checkup is in order?
units.displayText: Still, you've only just woken up. Perhaps a quick checkup is in order?

spans.text: Still, you've only just woken up. Perhaps a quick checkup is in order?

units.rawText: I'm fine. I was just knocked out by the blast from the sentry gun and fell asleep.
units.displayText: I'm fine. I was just knocked out by the blast from the sentry gun and fell asleep.

spans.text: I'm fine. I was just knocked out by the blast from the sentry gun and fell asleep.

units.rawText: Aw man, you missed my finest hour while you were out cold, Prof.
units.displayText: Aw man, you missed my finest hour while you were out cold, Prof.

spans.text: Aw man, you missed my finest hour while you were out cold, Prof.

units.rawText: Haha, did I now? What a shame.
units.displayText: Haha, did I now? What a shame.

spans.text: Haha, did I now? What a shame.

units.rawText: Actually... According to the results of the checkup, not only are you completely unharmed, the operand levels inside your body are higher than before we even set out.
units.displayText: Actually... According to the results of the checkup, not only are you completely unharmed, the operand levels inside your body are higher than before we even set out.

spans.text: Actually... According to the results of the checkup, not only are you completely unharmed, the operand levels inside your body are higher than before we even set out.

units.rawText: What exactly happened?
units.displayText: What exactly happened?

spans.text: What exactly happened?

units.rawText: Well, thanks to Malkira, that nap of mine wasn't exactly fruitless.
units.displayText: Well, thanks to Malkira, that nap of mine wasn't exactly fruitless.

spans.text: Well, thanks to Malkira, that nap of mine wasn't exactly fruitless.

units.rawText: So you're saying...
units.displayText: So you're saying...

spans.text: So you're saying...

units.rawText: Yes, after I passed out, Demiurge led me to an unfamiliar neural cloud space, where I met Malkira.
units.displayText: Yes, after I passed out, Demiurge led me to an unfamiliar neural cloud space, where I met Malkira.

spans.text: Yes, after I passed out, Demiurge led me to an unfamiliar neural cloud space, where I met Malkira.

units.rawText: She played her cards close to her chest and didn't reveal much to me beyond her relationship with Demiurge.
units.displayText: She played her cards close to her chest and didn't reveal much to me beyond her relationship with Demiurge.

spans.text: She played her cards close to her chest and didn't reveal much to me beyond her relationship with Demiurge.

units.rawText: Before she left, however, she used some technique to trap my neural cloud in darkness...
units.displayText: Before she left, however, she used some technique to trap my neural cloud in darkness...

spans.text: Before she left, however, she used some technique to trap my neural cloud in darkness...

units.rawText: When I think about the crushing despair inside that place, my mood immediately turns grim.
units.displayText: When I think about the crushing despair inside that place, my mood immediately turns grim.

spans.text: When I think about the crushing despair inside that place, my mood immediately turns grim.

units.rawText: There was no light or sound, and all attempts to call for help faded into nothing. All reason and conviction were slowly ground away into nothing by the darkness.
units.displayText: There was no light or sound, and all attempts to call for help faded into nothing. All reason and conviction were slowly ground away into nothing by the darkness.

spans.text: There was no light or sound, and all attempts to call for help faded into nothing. All reason and conviction were slowly ground away into nothing by the darkness.

units.rawText: Wow, that sounds scary... Still, what does this have to do with Malkira's goal?
units.displayText: Wow, that sounds scary... Still, what does this have to do with Malkira's goal?

spans.text: Wow, that sounds scary... Still, what does this have to do with Malkira's goal?

units.rawText: Now suffer as I have, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Now suffer as I have, {교수}.

spans.text: Now suffer as I have,

units.rawText: ...That darkness is the same thing that imprisons her. If that's the case, then everything makes sense.
units.displayText: ...That darkness is the same thing that imprisons her. If that's the case, then everything makes sense.

spans.text: ...That darkness is the same thing that imprisons her. If that's the case, then everything makes sense.

units.rawText: She wants to escape that cage and find release.
units.displayText: She wants to escape that cage and find release.

spans.text: She wants to escape that cage and find release.

units.rawText: But what can we do in order to help with that?
units.displayText: But what can we do in order to help with that?

spans.text: But what can we do in order to help with that?

units.rawText: We'll just have to ask her about it in person.
units.displayText: We'll just have to ask her about it in person.

spans.text: We'll just have to ask her about it in person.

units.rawText: Demiurge, who's standing off to the side, can't make heads or tails of our conversation. All she does is lean against me with wide eyes and nuzzle my hand.
units.displayText: Demiurge, who's standing off to the side, can't make heads or tails of our conversation. All she does is lean against me with wide eyes and nuzzle my hand.

spans.text: Demiurge, who's standing off to the side, can't make heads or tails of our conversation. All she does is lean against me with wide eyes and nuzzle my hand.

units.rawText: I'll take good care of you until we meet her, Demi.
units.displayText: I'll take good care of you until we meet her, Demi.

spans.text: I'll take good care of you until we meet her, Demi.

units.rawText: Well, time's running short. We'll use the Watchtower's repair equipment to heal up, then prepare to move out. I have the feeling that we've got a big battle ahead of us.
units.displayText: Well, time's running short. We'll use the Watchtower's repair equipment to heal up, then prepare to move out. I have the feeling that we've got a big battle ahead of us.

spans.text: Well, time's running short. We'll use the Watchtower's repair equipment to heal up, then prepare to move out. I have the feeling that we've got a big battle ahead of us.

units.rawText: Before we meet Malkira, however, there is one thing we need to do.
units.displayText: Before we meet Malkira, however, there is one thing we need to do.

spans.text: Before we meet Malkira, however, there is one thing we need to do.

units.rawText: I give Entropic Sol a meaningful look.
units.displayText: I give Entropic Sol a meaningful look.

spans.text: I give Entropic Sol a meaningful look.

units.rawText: To my knowledge, there are two more Watchtowers in the Middle Ring. Could you lead us to them?
units.displayText: To my knowledge, there are two more Watchtowers in the Middle Ring. Could you lead us to them?

spans.text: To my knowledge, there are two more Watchtowers in the Middle Ring. Could you lead us to them?

units.rawText: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: The rustling from outside the door interrupts Malkira's brief rest. The pet Entropic who has just returned from the outside proceeds to scramble up Malkira's leg and curls up on her thigh.
units.displayText: The rustling from outside the door interrupts Malkira's brief rest. The pet Entropic who has just returned from the outside proceeds to scramble up Malkira's leg and curls up on her thigh.

spans.text: The rustling from outside the door interrupts Malkira's brief rest. The pet Entropic who has just returned from the outside proceeds to scramble up Malkira's leg and curls up on her thigh.

units.rawText: You're back. It seems our guests are almost here.
units.displayText: You're back. It seems our guests are almost here.

spans.text: You're back. It seems our guests are almost here.

units.rawText: The pet Entropic chirps lazily.
units.displayText: The pet Entropic chirps lazily.

spans.text: The pet Entropic chirps lazily.

units.rawText: Shhh—the show is about to begin. Be patient and wait.
units.displayText: Shhh—the show is about to begin. Be patient and wait.

spans.text: Shhh—the show is about to begin. Be patient and wait.

units.rawText: I'm sure it will be a most exciting event.
units.displayText: I'm sure it will be a most exciting event.

spans.text: I'm sure it will be a most exciting event.

units.rawText: Just as she says that, the heavy doors to the throne room slowly swing open.
units.displayText: Just as she says that, the heavy doors to the throne room slowly swing open.

spans.text: Just as she says that, the heavy doors to the throne room slowly swing open.

units.rawText: A child runs in happily, heading straight to the throne like she's come home at long last.
units.displayText: A child runs in happily, heading straight to the throne like she's come home at long last.

spans.text: A child runs in happily, heading straight to the throne like she's come home at long last.

units.rawText: Mal... kira...
units.displayText: Mal... kira...

spans.text: Mal... kira...

units.rawText: Good girl.
units.displayText: Good girl.

spans.text: Good girl.

units.rawText: Malkira pats Demiurge's head and then hugs her.
units.displayText: Malkira pats Demiurge's head and then hugs her.

spans.text: Malkira pats Demiurge's head and then hugs her.

units.rawText: You've come back to me at last. It must have been hard.
units.displayText: You've come back to me at last. It must have been hard.

spans.text: You've come back to me at last. It must have been hard.

units.rawText: Sleep well, for you are home. When you awake, your dream will have become reality.
units.displayText: Sleep well, for you are home. When you awake, your dream will have become reality.

spans.text: Sleep well, for you are home. When you awake, your dream will have become reality.

units.rawText: The queen of the Entropic swarm pats the girl's back rhythmically, lulling her into sweet slumber.
units.displayText: The queen of the Entropic swarm pats the girl's back rhythmically, lulling her into sweet slumber.

spans.text: The queen of the Entropic swarm pats the girl's back rhythmically, lulling her into sweet slumber.

units.rawText: Footsteps from afar slowly approach.
units.displayText: Footsteps from afar slowly approach.

spans.text: Footsteps from afar slowly approach.

units.rawText: She calmly lays down the girl in her arms, placing her in a corner where her dreams will not be disturbed. Then, she turns to welcome her guests as a gracious host should.
units.displayText: She calmly lays down the girl in her arms, placing her in a corner where her dreams will not be disturbed. Then, she turns to welcome her guests as a gracious host should.

spans.text: She calmly lays down the girl in her arms, placing her in a corner where her dreams will not be disturbed. Then, she turns to welcome her guests as a gracious host should.

units.rawText: Upon her throne, the Entropic mastermind bows gracefully as a token of respect to her visitors from afar.
units.displayText: Upon her throne, the Entropic mastermind bows gracefully as a token of respect to her visitors from afar.

spans.text: Upon her throne, the Entropic mastermind bows gracefully as a token of respect to her visitors from afar.

units.rawText: You're here at last, <cmdr>. All this while, I've been waiting here for you.
units.displayText: You're here at last, {교수}. All this while, I've been waiting here for you.

spans.text: You're here at last,
. All this while, I've been waiting here for you.

units.rawText: ...Me too. I've been looking forward to this moment for a long time now.
units.displayText: ...Me too. I've been looking forward to this moment for a long time now.

spans.text: ...Me too. I've been looking forward to this moment for a long time now.

units.rawText: Hohoho, it seems we are both of the same mind.
units.displayText: Hohoho, it seems we are both of the same mind.

spans.text: Hohoho, it seems we are both of the same mind.

units.rawText: ...All the preparations are ready. The overture is playing and our guests have arrived.
units.displayText: ...All the preparations are ready. The overture is playing and our guests have arrived.

spans.text: ...All the preparations are ready. The overture is playing and our guests have arrived.

units.rawText: Now let the curtain rise on this marvelous dance!
units.displayText: Now let the curtain rise on this marvelous dance!

spans.text: Now let the curtain rise on this marvelous dance!

units.rawText: As she says that, countless savage tentacles rip through the air toward me.
units.displayText: As she says that, countless savage tentacles rip through the air toward me.

spans.text: As she says that, countless savage tentacles rip through the air toward me.

units.rawText: Everything happened too fast. Persicaria and Sol can't react in time. The Entropized girl beside me seems to have anticipated her leader's actions, because she steps in like a lightning bolt and blocks the attacks for me.
units.displayText: Everything happened too fast. Persicaria and Sol can't react in time. The Entropized girl beside me seems to have anticipated her leader's actions, because she steps in like a lightning bolt and blocks the attacks for me.

spans.text: Everything happened too fast. Persicaria and Sol can't react in time. The Entropized girl beside me seems to have anticipated her leader's actions, because she steps in like a lightning bolt and blocks the attacks for me.

units.rawText: Foom—the incoming tentacles are stopped by arcs of flame.
units.displayText: Foom—the incoming tentacles are stopped by arcs of flame.

spans.text: Foom—the incoming tentacles are stopped by arcs of flame.

units.rawText: Hohoho, are you betraying me, Sol?
units.displayText: Hohoho, are you betraying me, Sol?

spans.text: Hohoho, are you betraying me, Sol?

units.rawText: As Malkira's laughter fills the throne room, the people beside me spring into action.
units.displayText: As Malkira's laughter fills the throne room, the people beside me spring into action.

spans.text: As Malkira's laughter fills the throne room, the people beside me spring into action.

units.rawText: Sol!
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: The edge of her sword collides with the tentacles, as though it had struck an impenetrable shield.
units.displayText: The edge of her sword collides with the tentacles, as though it had struck an impenetrable shield.

spans.text: The edge of her sword collides with the tentacles, as though it had struck an impenetrable shield.

units.rawText: O lost lamb, explain the reason for your betrayal and plead for my forgiveness for your insolence.
units.displayText: O lost lamb, explain the reason for your betrayal and plead for my forgiveness for your insolence.

spans.text: O lost lamb, explain the reason for your betrayal and plead for my forgiveness for your insolence.

units.rawText: Lady Malkira, it was not my intention to betray you.
units.displayText: Lady Malkira, it was not my intention to betray you.

spans.text: Lady Malkira, it was not my intention to betray you.

units.rawText: However, I lost to them in our previous battle, so I hope you will give them a chance and speak calmly with them.
units.displayText: However, I lost to them in our previous battle, so I hope you will give them a chance and speak calmly with them.

spans.text: However, I lost to them in our previous battle, so I hope you will give them a chance and speak calmly with them.

units.rawText: "Them"?
units.displayText: "Them"?

spans.text: "Them"?

units.rawText: That's right, us, and me too.
units.displayText: That's right, us, and me too.

spans.text: That's right, us, and me too.

units.rawText: Everyone wants to know the truth.
units.displayText: Everyone wants to know the truth.

spans.text: Everyone wants to know the truth.

units.rawText: Malkira frowns, then looks down on her loyal subordinate from up on high.
units.displayText: Malkira frowns, then looks down on her loyal subordinate from up on high.

spans.text: Malkira frowns, then looks down on her loyal subordinate from up on high.

units.rawText: Hohoho, the truth... I have no idea what you're talking about.
units.displayText: Hohoho, the truth... I have no idea what you're talking about.

spans.text: Hohoho, the truth... I have no idea what you're talking about.

units.rawText: That data in my neural cloud was not redundant, but actual memories. Why did you lie to me and say that it was all fake?
units.displayText: That data in my neural cloud was not redundant, but actual memories. Why did you lie to me and say that it was all fake?

spans.text: That data in my neural cloud was not redundant, but actual memories. Why did you lie to me and say that it was all fake?

units.rawText: You were tormented by your identity, were you not? I simply gave you an answer beforehand.
units.displayText: You were tormented by your identity, were you not? I simply gave you an answer beforehand.

spans.text: You were tormented by your identity, were you not? I simply gave you an answer beforehand.

units.rawText: But running away is not the answer.
units.displayText: But running away is not the answer.

spans.text: But running away is not the answer.

units.rawText: What a shame, my child... You have rejected the path that I have created for you.
units.displayText: What a shame, my child... You have rejected the path that I have created for you.

spans.text: What a shame, my child... You have rejected the path that I have created for you.

units.rawText: I'll be blazing a new path of my own.
units.displayText: I'll be blazing a new path of my own.

spans.text: I'll be blazing a new path of my own.

units.rawText: Then show me your resolve!
units.displayText: Then show me your resolve!

spans.text: Then show me your resolve!

units.rawText: Hardly. You know too, don't you? She and I are of the same lineage, and no matter how severe our wounds, we will always be restored to our initial condition.
